Add to Preferred Sources Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi has given a timeline for Mathys Tel’s return following the knock the Frenchman picked up against Leeds United two weeks ago. 
 Mathys Tel finally looked to be finding some rhythm in a Tottenham Hotspur shirt before picking up that knock against Leeds United last time out.
 He had put in one of his best performances just two weeks earlier, scoring a lovely solo goal against Chelsea, and followed that with an impressive display against Crystal Palace that earned him a 7.9 FotMob rating – just 0.1 lower than his 8.0 against Chelsea.
 Tel’s newfound form even earned him a place in France’s preliminary senior squad for the international break that has just finished, which he missed because of his knock.
 Credit: @thatfootballphotog / Instagram Roberto De Zerbi gives Mathys Tel return timeline at Tottenham
 With club football back this weekend, Spurs boss Roberto De Zerbi has provided an update on the Frenchman.
 Spurs Web shared reports earlier in the week claiming that Tel’s injury was not as serious as initially feared , and now De Zerbi has provided a clear timeline.
 Speaking to football.london while providing an update on his squad, he said: “Bergvall, Maddison, Savio are back. Tosin & Tel no. Tosin is already OK but it’s not right moment to take any risk. Mathys Tel we need another 2-3 weeks. Mudryk is not ready yet.”

 While the Frenchman will be a big miss, Savio’s return has come at the perfect time for Tottenham, who were already starting to look thin on the left.
 Following Tel’s knock, De Zerbi had just Omar Marmoush and Luca Williams-Barnett as options on the left, but that surely changes with Savio back in the squad.
 The Tottenham boss will now be hoping that his side can return to winning ways after falling short against Leeds last time out, losing 1-0 at Elland Road.
